summary: Plan inclusive agribusiness ventures with market, business-model and costing tools. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: Inclusive agribusiness training helps entrepreneurs, enterprise advisers and producer-group leaders assess whether agricultural ventures are commercially viable and support inclusive market participation. It covers mapping value-chain actors, testing buyer and supplier needs, estimating startup costs and cash flow, and shaping a practical venture action plan using market-system and business-planning tools.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits people who develop, advise or operate agricultural enterprises and need to connect commercial viability with inclusive market participation. It is designed for professionals working directly with farm businesses, producer groups, agrifood buyers and enterprise-support programmes.
modules: FAO Sustainable Food Value Chain Lens
Value Proposition Canvas for Agrifood Buyers
Business Model Canvas for Inclusive Ventures
FAO RuralInvest Costing and Cash Flow
ILO SIYB Action Plan and Pitch
prerequisites: No formal agribusiness qualification is required. Familiarity with an agricultural enterprise idea, producer group or agrifood market is useful; no coding is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for the costing and tracker exercises. The Excel practice workbook and sample figures are provided; no specialist software is needed.
